turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey there, how have things been?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My sister keeps calling glamping real camping. It's not, right?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ha, it's a spicy topic. Glamping is camping with comforts, proper beds, sometimes electricity. Whether it counts depends who you ask.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She stayed in a yurt with a hot tub and a wine fridge.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, that's very far on the glamour end. Still outside though, technically.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Technically. I slept on a rock in the rain last month, so

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I feel like I've earned the right to judge.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You've definitely earned bragging rights. But maybe she'll get hooked and try the rock version next time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Doubt it. Would you count it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: I'd say if you hear the wind and owls at night, it's camping in spirit. The hot tub is just a very nice bonus.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It's a gift. Tell her she owes you one rainy weekend though.
